entities.name: Leopold Auerbach

entities.summary: Leopold Auerbach was a German Jewish anatomist and neuropathologist born in Breslau. He is best known for discovering the myenteric plexus also known as Auerbach's plexus, which helps control the gastrointestinal tract.
